LanguageData.HH.Scen.HarborTown.Intro:
The deed was signed in a hurry and the lawyer did not stay for tea. Now it is yours: a weathered inn above a quiet harbour, a road full of caravans and not a single guest.

Sweep the floors, mend the roof, make up a bed. Hang a sign. Somebody will knock before long - and if you treat them well, they will tell everyone on the road.

Tip: Hetty Hearthwell is the storyteller for builders. And the Hearth & Harbor guide at the top right explains one step at a time.
LanguageData.HH.Scen.BackRoom.Intro:
The letter was printed on heavy black paper and smelled faintly of cigars.

"Your debts have been settled. All of them. We will be in touch about the room behind the kitchen. Do keep it tidy."

Your waystation has new partners now. They are patient, they are polite, and they never, ever forget a number.

This start uses the darker content of Hearth & Harbor. You can tone it down at any time in the mod settings.
